puzzles.name: Goron Rescue Cells
puzzles.description: Free 6 Gorons from cells by hitting switches, bombing walls, and using Megaton Hammer on rusted switches.
steps: Cell 2: Hit switch through bars with Hookshot
Cell 4: Push block onto pressure plate
Cell 5: Song of Time on Time Block
Cell 6: Hookshot to ceiling, drop behind bars
puzzles.reward: Each Goron gives hint/key, all 6 needed for Boss Key

puzzles.name: Megaton Hammer Acquisition
puzzles.description: Navigate flame maze to reach Megaton Hammer chest. Requires precise timing through rotating fire bars.
steps: Enter flame maze with Goron Tunic
Time runs through rotating fire bars

puzzles.name: Song of Time Blocks
puzzles.description: Use Song of Time to make Time Blocks appear/disappear to create paths and access switches.
steps: Play Song of Time near Time Block (blue block with symbol)
Use as platform or to hold switch
Some puzzles require toggling multiple times
puzzles.reward: Access to new areas, Goron cells
hints: Song of Time particles reveal them

puzzles.name: Flare Dancer Puzzle
puzzles.description: Defeat Flare Dancers by hookshotting their spinning core, then attacking.
steps: Flare Dancer spins with fire aura

puzzles.name: Boss Key Boulder Maze
puzzles.description: Push boulders in lava maze to create path to Boss Key. Boulders sink in lava but create temporary platforms.
steps: Push boulders into lava to form path

puzzles.name: Volvagia Arena Access
puzzles.description: Hit crystal switch sequence to open path to Volvagia. Wrong order resets.
steps: Hit in order: Hammer, Bow, Sword
hints: Goron hint: "Hammer strikes first, then arrow flies, sword finishes"

phases.name: Rock Emergence
phases.mechanic: Volvagia flies through rock ceiling/floor, emerges to breathe fire
phases.puzzle: Megaton Hammer strike head when emerging from rock
phases.vulnerability: Head dazed after rock impact - hammer stuns

phases.name: Fire Breath Sweep
phases.mechanic: Volvagia sweeps fire breath across arena
phases.puzzle: Hide behind rocks, hammer head when close
phases.vulnerability: Brief hover before breath - hammer window

phases.name: Rock Fall Rain
phases.mechanic: Low health - Volvagia circles, rocks fall from ceiling
phases.puzzle: Dodge rocks, hammer head during low passes
